L10·N9334unmasked layer
This neuron gives its weak positive responses to continuation tokens inside e-commerce/spec-sheet boilerplate (Alibaba-style "Wholesale Various High Quality", "Find details about China", chemical ingredient lists, prices, timestamps), while its much larger effect is strong suppression on tokens that repeat a word already seen earlier in the passage (anti-induction: "Sahara"…"Sahara", "Ball"…"Ball", "Dead"+"lift" after "deadlifts").

L10·N9969unmasked layer
Fires on the final token that completes a (often multi-token, technical/proper) noun ending a noun phrase — e.g. "-alsy" in palsy, " nec"(rosis), "-is" in Patois, " failure", " theft" — while being strongly suppressed on tokens that are the modifier part of a compound and are still followed by a head noun (drift-wood, compost-ed bark, fossil-ized footprint, wind-ch-ill factor).
